### Unum Group to Release Third Quarter 2026 Results and Host Conference Call


October 7, 2026


CHATTANOOGA, Tenn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Unum Group (NYSE: UNM) will release its third quarter 2026 results on November 3, 2026, at approximately 4:15 p.m. ET. The earnings release and financial supplement will be available in the investors section of the company’s[website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Funumgroup.com&esheet=54617770&newsitemid=20261007945763&lan=en-US&anchor=website&index=1&md5=817514a4ae388997a93dd0677f5f5fb0) , which can be directly accessed at[https://investors.unum.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.unum.com%2F&esheet=54617770&newsitemid=20261007945763&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.unum.com&index=2&md5=2222da97139d327b71e9de6c070b287e) .


Members of Unum Group’s senior management will host a conference call on November 4, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. ET to discuss third quarter results. Topics may include forward-looking information, such as guidance on future results or trends in operations, as well as other material information. Interested parties are invited to listen and participate in the question-and-answer segment.


To receive dial-in information for the call, please register in advance through the URL below.


**Dial In Registration URL** :[https://registrations.events/direct/Q4I33079VIPd1LPgnNnne0SpG](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.com%2Fv3%2F__https%3A%2Fregistrations.events%2Fdirect%2FQ4I33079VIPd1LPgnNnne0SpG__%3B%21%21ImvX4A%21NJQcfZihqVhsE6qyXr5MRMIV7gROVYDttox02jnqnphMG6ovDsZ24XP3pBtFMipFBmzmpQzgwSPoaa-qNS0AH0M%24&esheet=54617770&newsitemid=20261007945763&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fregistrations.events%2Fdirect%2FQ4I33079VIPd1LPgnNnne0SpG&index=3&md5=4c7ad6885ca3fc56846d146fb0823697)


A live webcast of the call will be available in a listen-only mode. Participants should access the webcast approximately 10 minutes before the call.


**Webcast URL:**[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/749785874](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.com%2Fv3%2F__https%3A%2Fwww.google.com%2Furl%3Fq%3Dhttps*3A*2F*2Fevents.q4inc.com*2Fattendee*2F749785874%26sa%3DD%26source%3Dcalendar%26ust%3D1791643680000000%26usg%3DAOvVaw00qztdJjX3P41ZCz6-jXC7__%3BJSUlJSU%21%21ImvX4A%21JobCNxJ4n8NwoTC2JwcY3iKfiYddA3F6Vi206C_LLwFyk5T9BilYYbTii-2BC4wzLKkqQXJd8oaPV3LovYav1ok%24&esheet=54617770&newsitemid=20261007945763&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F749785874&index=4&md5=f6d69113b2ce0b55907506dc4eb2f660)


Unum will keep a recording of the call on the Investor site through November 11, 2026. The replay can be accessed through the same dial-in registration URL above.


**Anticipated future earnings release dates / conference call dates & times:**


Fourth Quarter 2026 – February 2nd / February 3rd 8 a.m.


First Quarter 2027 – May 4th / May 5th 8 a.m.


**About Unum Group**


[Unum Group](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.unumgroup.com%2F&esheet=54617770&newsitemid=20261007945763&lan=en-US&anchor=Unum+Group&index=5&md5=60a9a5107a408aea593cc2d81aa11ab2) (NYSE: UNM), a leading international provider of workplace benefits and services, has been helping workers and their families thrive for more than 175 years. Through its Unum and Colonial Life brands, the company offers disability, life, accident, critical illness, dental, and vision insurance; leave and absence management support; and behavioral health services. In 2025, Unum Group reported revenues of $13.1 billion and paid $8.3 billion in benefits. The Fortune 500 company is recognized as one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies by Ethisphere®.
